guardEvidence.citation: tests/unit/enrollment-wizard.test.ts#expired Claude login, healthy account, slot answers as expected → closed, no new code, loop over
guardEvidence.howCaught: Control-loop edge: reissue tick -> re-drive -> new pending login -> next expiry -> re-drive. Steady-state bound: for a Claude login whose account the pool holds active and whose slot answers live as the expected email, the loop ends after one identity read; the test asserts no re-drive and no further read on the next sweep. Settling brake: completing the login removes it from the expired set. Other logins keep the pre-existing one re-drive per 15-minute TTL.
